scheme_name: Self Employment Scheme For Rehabilitation Of Manual Scavengers
other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged or employed as a Manual Scavenger by an individual, local authority, agency or contractor as identified during the survey conducted by State Governments and allotted an MS‑ID/Receipt No.
Dependents of identified manual scavengers are eligible for the scheme.
Sanitation workers and their dependents are eligible only for assistance for sanitation‑related self‑employment projects.
Identification of manual scavengers is done by the concerned State Governments through surveys by Urban Local Bodies or Gram Panchayats.
benefits_summary: Provides one‑time cash assistance of ₹40,000, project‑based capital subsidy up to ₹5 lakh, concessional loans, skill‑development training with a stipend, and health‑insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh.
